Package hadur2.core.policy

Class PowerPolicy

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.policy.PowerPolicy
public final class PowerPolicy extends Object
When to fire full power instead of the gun's own choice. Landing a power-3 bullet refunds 9 energy and deals 16, so against a gun that rarely hits us full power is energy-positive at any distance.
  • POW-1: where the profile rates their gun T0 and their energy exceeds 12, fire 3.0. A tier is only named once its own margin is narrow (see Tiers), so this is already DIAL-1's form.
  • POW-2: while this battle shows our rolling hit rate above OUR_RATE and theirs below THEIR_RATE, each by more than its margin of error (measured from the estimate's centre, see Estimate.center()), fire 3.0. Uncertain rates keep the gun's own power (DIAL-1).

In both, the shot is still capped at a quarter of their energy, which is what kills them, so a finishing shot never wastes energy. Neither applies while our own energy is MIN_OUR_ENERGY or less: there the gun's power-down in a losing energy war stands, because a full-power miss could leave us disabled.

HadurCore asks on every duel aim: the gun proposes a power, reason(hadur2.core.memory.Tiers.Gun, double, double, hadur2.core.memory.Estimate, hadur2.core.memory.Estimate) says whether a policy overrides it, and power(hadur2.core.policy.PowerPolicy.Reason, double, double) gives the power the wave and the shot carry. Both methods are pure.

  • Method Details

    • reason

      public static PowerPolicy.Reason reason(Tiers.Gun gunTier, double enemyEnergy, double ourEnergy, Estimate ours, Estimate theirs)
      The reason full power applies, or PowerPolicy.Reason.GUN to keep the gun's choice.

      Checked in order: our own energy first (at MIN_OUR_ENERGY or below nothing applies), then POW-1, then POW-2. POW-2 needs both rates known and each bound clear by a full margin: our centre less our margin above OUR_RATE, their centre plus their margin below THEIR_RATE.

      Parameters:
      gunTier - the profile's tier for their gun; UNKNOWN unless its margin is narrow
      enemyEnergy - their energy at the scan, in energy
      ourEnergy - our energy, in energy
      ours - our rolling hit rate on them
      theirs - their rolling hit rate on us
      Returns:
      which rule, if any, sets the power

    • power

      public static double power(PowerPolicy.Reason reason, double gunPower, double enemyEnergy)
      The power to fire: gunPower unless a reason applies, then FULL_POWER capped at a quarter of their energy, never below the gun's own choice.

      A bullet of power p takes 4p up to power 1, so a quarter of their energy is exactly a killing shot at 4 energy or less, and more than enough above that.

      Parameters:
      reason - the reason from reason(hadur2.core.memory.Tiers.Gun, double, double, hadur2.core.memory.Estimate, hadur2.core.memory.Estimate)
      gunPower - the power the gun chose, in energy
      enemyEnergy - their energy, in energy
      Returns:
      the power to fire, in energy
